text: In a hostel, 2/3 of residents eat breakfast and 3/4 eat dinner. Exactly 1/2 of all residents eat both. What fraction eat at least one of the two meals?
Office backup 23:40 par shuru hota hai aur agle din 01:15 par khatam hota hai. Beech mein 10 minute ka pause hai. Backup kitne minute actively chala?
Library cabinet ka two-digit code 3 par end hota hai. Digits reverse karne par bhi two-digit code banta hai. Original code minus reversed code 27 hai. Original code ka first digit kya hai?

Event hall mein 96 chairs hain. Camera lane banane ke liye staff 14 chairs hall se bahar shift karta hai, phir unmein se 6 chairs wapas laakar back wall ke paas set kar deta hai. Ab hall mein total kitni chairs hain?
Phone recharge mein INR 100 ka credit INR 92 mein milta hai. Aise 3 credits khareedkar INR 245 ka credit kharch kiya. Ab kitna credit bacha hai?
Library catalogue mein 150 entries hain, aur exactly 60% check ho chuki hain. Catalogue ka 80% reach karne ke liye kitni unchecked entries aur check karni hongi?

An event serving line has a plating station handling 18 meals per minute and a handover station handling 6 fewer meals per minute. Every meal passes through both. With enough food and no other delays, what is the line's maximum sustained output per minute?
A phone's listed repair price is increased by 20 percent and then the new price is reduced by 20 percent. What percentage of the original price is the final price?
Phone service ka yearly renewal INR 1440 hai, jo 12 monthly renewals ke total se INR 180 kam hai. Agar har mahine ka renewal same hai, toh ek mahine ka kitna hoga?
Library scanner har minute 7 pages scan karta hai. 180-page batch mein se 40 pages already scan ho chuke hain. Remaining pages ko bina pause scan karne mein aur kitne minutes lagenge?

Event ki plating station har minute 18 meals ready karti hai. Handover station har minute 6 meals kam handle karti hai. Har meal dono se guzarta hai. Bina aur delays ke line ka maximum per-minute output kitna hoga?
Library ki do wall coverings ki height same hai aur widths ka ratio 3:5 hai. Patli covering par 12 L paint lagta hai. Same coverage rate par chaudi covering par kitna paint lagega?
Courier ne teen distances tay kiye: x ka aadha, x ka ek tihaai aur aakhri 4 km. Total trip 19 km hai. x kitne km hai?
A phone stores a compressed file at one quarter of its original size, then attaches a fixed 6 MB header. The resulting file occupies 23 MB. How large was the original file in MB?
Library mein 24 repaired books aur 20 books repair ke liye pending hain. Repaired-to-pending ratio 3:2 karna hai. Kisi book ka status change kiye bina kitni already repaired donated books chahiye?
Office team ne Monday ko report ka 5/8 complete kiya. Tuesday ko team ne unfinished work ka 2/5 complete kiya. Tuesday ko complete hua kaam poori report ka kitna fraction hai?
A phone plan carries unused data into tomorrow, but only up to 2 GB. Today 3.5 GB is unused, and tomorrow's fresh allowance is 1.5 GB. How much data will be available tomorrow?
A rainfall gauge contains 18 mL. This is 3/4 of its capacity. After 2 mL evaporates, what fraction of capacity is filled?
A library has 40 reference books, of which 10 are illustrated, and 60 lending books, of which 30 are illustrated. What fraction of all these books is illustrated?
A delivery log records 15 completed stops out of 24 assigned stops. Write the completed fraction in lowest terms. What is its numerator?
Library mein 40 reference books hain, jinmein 10 illustrated hain; 60 lending books mein 30 illustrated hain. Total books ka kitna fraction illustrated hai?
Office ke training room mein interview room ke mukable 3 guna seats hain. Interview room mein 14 seats hain. Training room mein kitni seats hongi?
Hostel ka tank full tha. Breakfast mein 1/4 paani use hua aur lunch mein original paani ka 1/3. Shuru ke paani ka kitna fraction bacha?
Event ka sound bill INR 3600 hai. Sponsor INR 900 de deta hai aur bacha amount 3 organising groups mein barabar bant ta hai. Har group kitne rupaye dega?
A park's map uses 45% of its area for woodland and 30% for grassland, with no overlap. What percentage of the non-woodland area is grassland?
Auto 30 minute mein 12 km chalta hai, 10 minute rukta hai, aur agle 20 minute mein 8 km chalta hai. Is poore ek ghante mein average speed kitni km/h hai?
Wedding rehearsal ka exact midpoint 14:35 hai aur rehearsal usi afternoon 15:10 par khatam hoti hai. Yeh 13:00 ke kitne minute baad shuru hui?
Library mein manuscript copy karne ke INR 240 lage. Reader ne INR 300 diye aur change mein se INR 25 donate karne ko kaha. Library ko kitne rupaye return karne hain?
Shaadi ke abhyaas ki shuruaat aur ant ke theek madhya ka samay 14:35 hai. Abhyaas usi dopahar 15:10 par khatm hota hai. Vah 13:00 se kitne minute baad shuru hua?
A clinic's weekly attendance changes from 80 patients to 92. Express the increase as a fraction of the new attendance.
For a delivery of x kilometres, one auto service quotes INR (40 + 12*x), and another quotes INR (64 + 8*x). At what distance are the quotes equal?
Hospital ke do wards mein 48 lockers 5:3 ke ratio mein baante gaye. Doosre ward ko kitne lockers milenge?
At a wedding gate, guests and staff arrive in the ratio 9:2. On average, staff make up 1 out of every k arrivals, where k need not be a whole number. What is k?

A courier's loaded-to-empty distance ratio is 5:2. Loaded travel is 30 km. What fraction of the whole distance is empty travel?
A phone plays a 48-minute recording at 1.5 times normal speed. Playback stops for a 6-minute call, then resumes at the same speed. What is the elapsed time from start to finish?
